QuestInfo.name: A Boy's Romance
QuestInfo.0: Utah has something to say to you. He is hesident and doesn't look himself. Go find out what is wrong.
QuestInfo.1: Utah felt bad for making Camila cry, so he asked Alpha and Beta to get her a gift.
QuestInfo.2: Alpha and Beta got the gift for Camila like Utah asked, but they also got a little revenge on him while they were at it. Heh.

0.0: Hey... Do you know #bCamila#k? She's the prettiest girl in town. Umm, not that I noticed! I-I-I'm not interested in her at all! . I just, um... I just feel sorry for her, that's all! I swear! Actually, she cried today because of something I said. I just don't know what she sees in Evan.
0.1: I didn't mean to make her cry though... I need to be a man and take responsibility! Girls dig that, right? Also, will you help me? Because that sounds hard.

yes.0: Girls like shiny stuff, right? Like marbles? You know, stuff like #r#t4033786##k. Can you go get #rone #t4033786##k for Camila? D-don't get me wrong, I just want her to stop crying. That's all.

no.0: Ugh, I'm just sick of watching her cry! She's so snotty and red.

default.0: How will I ever face Evan again?

npc.0: #r#t4033786##k will make her stop crying, right? Maybe I can see her smile...
